high_level_description: The image is a photograph that has been awarded as the winner in the Editorial Photography – Photojournalism category. The title of the winning entry is "Svartsengi" by Marco Di Marco. The photograph captures a dramatic scene of a volcanic eruption at night. The setting is a barren landscape, likely a volcanic area, with the ground covered in dark, rugged terrain. The most striking feature is the bright orange glow emanating from the lava flow, which is flowing down a central path, creating a striking contrast against the dark surroundings.
